<includeonly>{{#invoke:Erenshor/ZoneRoster|roster}}</includeonly><noinclude>
Shows the zone's characters by encounter tier, with level ranges and exported spawn conditions. Spawn chances describe eligible spawn rolls, not zone-wide encounter probabilities. Scripted encounters imply no fixed spawn position.

Place <code><nowiki>{{Zone roster}}</nowiki></code> on a zone page. Use <code><nowiki>{{Zone roster|stablekey=zone:abyssal}}</nowiki></code> to select a zone explicitly. Editor-written sub-area notes stay outside the view.
</noinclude>
